items.title: Application Tips for Oily Skin
items.text: Keep prep lightweight. According to makeup artists interviewed by Allure, heavy moisturizers create excess slip that breaks down foundation. Apply a lightweight, oil-free moisturizer and let it absorb completely before makeup. Allure Apply in thin layers. Build coverage gradually only where you need it rather than applying one thick coat. Target your powder. Press a finely milled setting powder onto your T-zone and other shine-prone areas instead of powdering your entire face. Blot before touching up. Use blotting papers to lift excess oil before adding more powder so your makeup does not cake.
items.markdown:
- **Keep prep lightweight.** According to makeup artists interviewed by Allure , heavy moisturizers create excess slip that breaks down foundation. Apply a lightweight, oil-free moisturizer and let it absorb completely before makeup.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-foundation-for-acne)
- **Apply in thin layers.** Build coverage gradually only where you need it rather than applying one thick coat.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-foundation-for-acne)
- **Target your powder.** Press a finely milled setting powder onto your T-zone and other shine-prone areas instead of powdering your entire face.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-foundation-for-acne)
- **Blot before touching up.** Use blotting papers to lift excess oil before adding more powder so your makeup does not cake.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-foundation-for-acne)
